name: 4D Labs
steps: Open dapp.4dlabs.space/tasks directly. Warning We found no task that asks for a seed phrase. Anyone who asks for yours is running a scam.
Log in with "a crypto wallet, a traditional email address, or a social media account such as Google or X". Check-ins need a connected EVM wallet, so use a spare one instead of your main wallet.
Put a little BNB in that wallet on BNB Chain. Each check-in is a transaction, and you pay the gas.
Pick a continent and press Check In each day. The docs recommend "checking in on the continent where you are located", but all six pay the same.
Join the Discord server and the Telegram channel from the Social section. That's 100 Score without touching your X account.
Check your Score, rank and linked accounts on the Profile page, and follow t.me/official_4dlabs for news of later seasons.
what: No 4D Labs airdrop is confirmed. Season 1 pays Score for BNB Chain check-ins, social tasks and referrals, and $4D isn't live. Steps, costs and risks.
behind: The site, docs and whitepaper name no team. Odaily's report on the EASY Residency Season 2 cohort, dated 3 December 2025, lists Bruce Bai as CEO and Ian Y. Xu, Xin Zhou and Haoming as co-founders. It describes Bai as a Zhejiang University PhD who founded two computer vision startups. Funding came through that program. costs: The project says: "Only a small network gas fee applies. 4D Labs charges no check-in fee." Social tasks cost nothing, and we found no deposit, mint or stake in Season 1. We didn't sign a check-in, so we can't give a gas figure. Checking in daily means one paid transaction a day for as long as the season runs, so keep only a small amount of BNB in that wallet. risks: Excluded: no country list is published. You "must be at least 18 years old", and you can't take part where it's "prohibited by applicable law, sanctions, export controls, or an agreement binding on you".
